ابتذلتم (form VIII)
# اِبْتَذَلْتُمْ (ibtaḏaltum) /ib.ta.ðal.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اُبْتُذِلْتُمْ (ubtuḏiltum) /ub.tu.ðil.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
